author: K_R_Cord
body:
Hello Everyone!

Pie and I have decided that we will be hosting more throwback events in the future.  For this to work, we would want your input on which maps we should be putting into events more. 
Below please state your favorite maps. You can say as much as you want and the more the better. Use the list below if you need help remembering maps. We can XML any map.
List
List

Thank you for your input and I can't wait to get this started!
